edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. It writes your spacing rules. - E Unbreakable is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Rocket Grab (Q) cds 20/19/18/17/16s — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. - Power Fist (E) resets his auto for a knockup; the wind-up is your cue to step back. - Mana Barrier (P) and Static Field (R) shield burst — force it out before you commit your all-in.
